form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: A unique name for these credentials. Other settings, such as HTTP TLS key stores, refer to credentials by this name.

form:FormGroup.label: Credentials expire
form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick if these credentials have an expiry date, then set it in Expires.

form:FormGroup.label: Expires
form:FormGroup.helpText: The date and time the credentials expire. This is shown in the credentials list as a reminder; Stroom does not stop using them after this time.

form:FormGroup.label: Type
form:FormGroup.helpText: The kind of credentials: Username / Password, Access Token, SSH Key or Key Store. The secret fields change to match. Default is Username / Password.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Username / Password, Access Token, SSH Key or Key Store.
